issues.description: DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE duplicated across Python, TS constant, and TS fallback literal — no single source of truth.
issues.detail: 'python:3.12' is defined in pipeline.py, redefined as a constant in CellMetadataEditor.tsx, and hardcoded as a fallback in Commands.ts. The new RPC was supposed to centralize this. A future bump (e.g., python:3.13) will silently desync. Trust the RPC with one clearly-marked emergency fallback, or drop the RPC.

issues.description: Silent behavior change: _set_base_image now pins python:3.12 instead of deferring to kfp default.
issues.detail: Previously, on pod-introspection failure, base_image='' meant 'let kfp choose'. The diff now forces 'python:3.12', a real runtime change for every user whose pod lookup fails. The empty-string sentinel contract is gone. Split this semantic change from the UI work and document it explicitly, or restore the delegate-to-kfp behavior.

issues.description: Effective-base-image precedence chain (step > pipeline > default) reimplemented in three sites.
issues.detail: The same fallback chain appears in the Jinja template, the dialog placeholder, and InlineMetadata's createBaseImageText. This is an ADT operation that belongs in one named helper (e.g., resolveBaseImage(step, pipeline, default)) with a stated contract. Independent copies will drift.

issues.description: Replacing inline Input with a 5%-wide IMAGE button + modal is a UX regression and a leaky layout contract.
issues.detail: The old UI let users type the image directly. The new 5%-wide button labeled 'IMAGE' opens a modal, requires stepName first, and depends on parent flex context to render predictably. The Input width also drops 35%→30% with no explanation. Either preserve inline editability or justify the stronger precondition and own the layout contract.

issues.description: get_default_base_image uses a function-local import, hiding the module dependency.
issues.detail: `from kale.pipeline import DEFAULT_BASE_IMAGE` inside the RPC body obscures the rpc.nb → pipeline dependency, pays import cost per call, and violates codebase convention. compiler.py already imports it at top level. Move the import to the module header.

issues.description: createBaseImageText now always renders, potentially displaying base image on non-step cells.
issues.detail: Previously the component returned '' when no baseImage was set; now it unconditionally renders 'Base Image: <default> (default)'. If the caller doesn't gate by cellType, imports/functions/skip cells will show a meaningless base image line. Verify the gating and document the new layout invariant.

synthesis.summary: NEEDS-WORK. The panel agrees this PR was sold as a display feature but quietly changes runtime semantics in pipeline.py (empty-string-defer-to-kfp → forced python:3.12) and duplicates the default image constant across Python, a TS constant, and a TS fallback literal — defeating the purpose of the new RPC. The IMAGE button + modal replacing the inline Input is a UX regression with a fragile 5% width. Split the semantic change from the UI work, centralize the default and the precedence chain in one place, and reconsider the editor affordance.
